big_case.notes: Pro se application asking the Circuit Justice to halt a Tennessee home foreclosure, a state misdemeanor prosecution and an HOA garnishment, and to enter merits judgment. Fact-bound, no question of wider reach; denied by the Chief Justice alone in a one-line order with no response, referral or amicus.
